facts.statement: A sauropod skull was discovered in 1997 by Rubén D.F. Martínez at the Estancia Laguna Palacios in Chubut province.
facts.quote: In 1997, paleontologist Rubén D.F. Martínez, at the Estancia Laguna Palacios of the Goicoechea family in Chubut province, discovered a sauropod skull.

facts.statement: The species Sarmientosaurus musacchioi was named and described in 2016 by a team including Rubén D.F. Martínez and Lawrence M. Witmer.
facts.quote: In 2016, the type species Sarmientosaurus musacchioi was named and described by Rubén Darío Francisco Martínez, Matthew Carl Lamanna, Fernando Emilio Novas, Ryan C. Ridgely, Gabriel Andrés Casal, Javier E. Martínez, Javier R. Vita and Lawrence M. Witmer.

facts.statement: The holotype specimen MDT-PV 2 was found in the Bajo Barreal Formation, which dates from the Cenomanian to Turonian ages.
facts.quote: The holotype, MDT-PV 2, was found in the upper Lower Member of the Bajo Barreal Formation, dating from the Cenomanian to Turonian ages.

facts.statement: The holotype specimen represents an elderly individual.
facts.quote: The specimen represents an elderly individual.

facts.statement: An elongated structure identified as an ossified tendon was uniquely discovered at the side of the neck.
facts.quote: Uniquely, at the side of the neck an elongated structure was discovered that was identified as an ossified tendon.

facts.statement: The describing authors identified nine unique distinguishing traits, known as autapomorphies.
facts.quote: The describing authors indicated nine unique distinguishing traits, autapomorphies.

facts.statement: The eye socket is exceptionally large, equalling 40% of the skull's length.
facts.quote: The eye socket is large, equalling 40% of the length of the skull.

facts.statement: The moderately elongated teeth have sharply-angled wear facets and a unique orientation that suggests a special, currently unexplained method of cropping vegetation.
facts.quote: The teeth are moderately elongated. They each have sharply-angled wear facets in a high and a low position which, together with their strange orientation, indicates some special, as yet not fully understood, way of cropping vegetation.

facts.statement: The neck structure had an oval cross-section and a rough, striated surface.
facts.quote: It had an oval cross-section and a rough and striated surface.

facts.statement: Researchers assumed the structure was an ossified tendon internal to a neck muscle, rather than a continuation of a neck rib.
facts.quote: Such tendons might have been a continuation of the neck ribs, but again, its position did not confirm this. Instead, it was assumed to have been internal to some neck muscle.

facts.statement: The internal structure of the tendon indicates that it ossified rapidly at a young age.
facts.quote: The internal structure of the tendon, with much reworked bone tissue, indicated a swift ossification at a young age.

facts.statement: Ossified tendons of this type have never been found in fossil dinosaurs, though they exist in some extant bird groups like cranes, but are much shorter.
facts.quote: Such ossified tendons have never before been found in any fossil dinosaur but some extant bird groups such as the cranes show them, though they are relatively shorter, at most two vertebrae long.

facts.statement: Based on ear and neck tendon evidence, Sarmientosaurus likely held its head and neck down low, similar to the character Eeyore.
facts.quote: Based on the ear and neck tendon, Sarmientosaurus most likely hung its head and neck down "like an enormous Eeyore".

facts.statement: This low head posture implies Sarmientosaurus may have fed on lower-lying plants compared to other sauropods.
facts.quote: This posture implies that Sarmientosaurus may have eaten much lower-lying plants than other sauropods.

facts.statement: Sarmientosaurus lived in what is now Argentina during the Upper Cretaceous Period, approximately 95 million years ago.
facts.quote: It lived in what is now South America, specifically Argentina, during the Upper Cretaceous Period about 95 million years ago.

facts.statement: Remains were found in Argentina in strata dating from the Cenomanian to Turonian stages of the Upper Cretaceous Period.
facts.quote: Sus restos fueron hallados en Argentina, en estratos que datan de las épocas del Cenomaniense al Turoniense del período Cretácico Superior.

facts.statement: In 2021, Stephen Poropat and colleagues reclassified Sarmientosaurus as part of the clade Diamantinasauria.
facts.quote: However, in 2021, Stephen Poropat and colleagues instead identified it as part of the new clade Diamantinasauria, along with Savannasaurus and Diamantinasaurus.

facts.statement: Sarmientosaurus is classified within the unranked family Lithostrotia.
facts.quote: unranked_familia: Lithostrotia

facts.statement: Sarmientosaurus was estimated to reach a length of 12 meters and a weight of 10 tonnes.
facts.quote: Sarmientosaurus tiene una longitud estimada de 12 metros y un peso de 10 toneladas.

facts.statement: Researchers identified nine unique distinguishing traits, known as autapomorphies, for Sarmientosaurus.
facts.quote: Los autores que describieron indicaron nueve rasgos distintivos únicos, autapomorfias.

facts.statement: The eye socket of Sarmientosaurus was exceptionally large, accounting for 40% of the skull's length.
facts.quote: La cuenca del ojo es grande, equivale al 40% de la longitud del cráneo.

facts.statement: The neurocranium of Sarmientosaurus had three separate exits for the trigeminal nerve.
facts.quote: En el neurocráneo hay tres salidas separadas para el nervio trigémino.

facts.statement: The skull of Sarmientosaurus measured 43 centimeters in length.
facts.quote: El cráneo tiene una longitud de 43 centímetros.

facts.statement: The jugal bone of Sarmientosaurus had an unusual L-shape with a very long front branch and an almost absent rear branch.
facts.quote: El hueso yugal tiene una forma de L inusual con una rama delantera muy larga y una rama trasera casi ausente.

facts.statement: Sarmientosaurus possessed a unique dental configuration where premaxillary teeth stood vertically, maxillary teeth tilted forward, and dentary teeth tilted backward.
facts.quote: Los dientes premaxilares se colocan verticalmente, los dientes maxilares se inclinan hacia adelante mientras que los dientes de la mandíbula inferior se inclinan hacia atrás, una configuración única.

facts.statement: The moderately elongated teeth of Sarmientosaurus featured sharp angled wear facets in high and low positions, suggesting a special, currently unexplained method of processing vegetation.
facts.quote: Los dientes están moderadamente alargados. Cada uno de ellos tiene facetas de desgaste en ángulo agudo en una posición alta y baja que, junto con su extraña orientación, indica alguna forma especial, aún no entendida del todo, de cultivar la vegetación.

facts.statement: The neck vertebrae of Sarmientosaurus were long and elongated with many small air spaces inside their structure.
facts.quote: Las vértebras del cuello son largas y alargadas. Su estructura interna posee muchos pequeños espacios de aire en su interior.

facts.statement: The neck ribs of Sarmientosaurus were delicate, thin, and rod-shaped.
facts.quote: Las costillas del cuello son delicadas, delgadas y en forma de varilla.

facts.statement: A cable-like structure with a constant diameter of three millimeters was found running parallel to the ribs on the outside of the neck.
facts.quote: Paralelamente a las nervaduras, en el lado exterior del cuello se descubrió una estructura en forma de cable con un diámetro constante de tres milímetros.

facts.statement: This structure originated directly behind the skull and continued along several vertebrae, spanning several meters in length.
facts.quote: La estructura se originó directamente detrás del cráneo y continuó a lo largo de varias vértebras, por lo tanto, de algunos metros.

facts.statement: Such ossified tendons had never been found in any fossil dinosaur before, though some existing bird groups like cranes possess them, albeit shorter, extending at most two vertebrae long.
facts.quote: Tales tendones osificados nunca antes se habían encontrado en ningún dinosaurio fósil, pero algunos grupos de aves existentes como ellas grullas las muestran, aunque son relativamente más cortas, a lo sumo dos vértebras de largo.

facts.statement: Paleontologist Rubén D.F. Martínez discovered a sauropod skull in 1997 at Estancia Laguna Palacios in the province of Chubut.
facts.quote: En 1997, el paleontólogo Rubén D.F. Martínez descubrió un cráneo de saurópodo en la Estancia Laguna Palacios, propiedad de la familia Goicoechea en la provincia de Chubut.

facts.statement: The species Sarmientosaurus musacchioi was named and described in 2016 by Rubén Darío Francisco Martínez and colleagues.
facts.quote: En 2016 se nombró y describió a la especie Sarmientosaurus musacchioi por Rubén Darío Francisco Martínez, Matthew Carl Lamanna, Fernando Emilio Novas, Ryan C. Ridgely, Gabriel Andrés Casal, Javier E. Martínez, Javier R. Vita y Lawrence M. Witmer.

facts.statement: The genus name Sarmientosaurus refers to the town of Sarmiento.
facts.quote: El nombre del género se refiere al pueblo de Sarmiento.

facts.statement: The species name honors the late Eduardo Musacchio, an educator at the Universidad Nacional de la Patagonia San Juan Bosco.
facts.quote: El nombre de la especie es en honor del difunto Eduardo Musacchio, un educador de la Universidad Nacional de la Patagonia San Juan Bosco.

facts.statement: The holotype specimen, MDT-PV 2, was found in the upper layer of the Lower Member of the Bajo Barreal Formation, dating from the Cenomanian to Turonian periods.
facts.quote: El espécimen holotipo, MDT-PV 2, fue hallado en la capa superior del Miembro Inferior de la Formación Bajo Barreal, la cal data de las épocas del Cenomaniense al Turoniense.

facts.statement: The holotype consists of an almost complete skull with jaws articulated with the first seven neck vertebrae.
facts.quote: Consiste de un cráneo casi completo con mandíbulas, articulado con las primeras siete vértebras del cuello.

facts.statement: A notable finding was an elongated structure found alongside the neck, identified as an ossified tendon.
facts.quote: Un hallazgo notable lo constituye una estructura alargada que fue hallada al lado del cuello, que fue identificada como un tendón osificado.

facts.statement: Sarmientosaurus lived during the Cenomanian to Turonian epochs.
facts.quote: la cal data de las épocas del Cenomaniense al Turoniense.

facts.statement: Sarmientosaurus lived between 100.5 and 89.8 million years ago.
facts.quote: Time range: Cenomanian to Turonian (100.5 to 89.8 million years ago)

facts.statement: Sarmientosaurus belongs to the parent group Diamantinasauria.
facts.quote: Parent group: Diamantinasauria

facts.statement: Martínez and colleagues placed Sarmientosaurus in a basal position within the clade Lithostrotia, above Malawisaurus on the evolutionary tree.
facts.quote: Martínez y sus colegas colocaron Sarmientosaurus en una posición basal dentro del clado Lithostrotia, por encima de Malawisaurus en el árbol evolutivo.

facts.statement: However, in 2021, Stephen Poropat and colleagues identified Sarmientosaurus as part of the new clade Diamantinasauria, along with Savannasaurus and Diamantinasaurus.
facts.quote: Sin embargo, en 2021, Stephen Poropat y sus colegas lo identificaron como parte del nuevo clado Diamantinasauria, junto con Savannasaurus y Diamantinasaurus.

facts.statement: Sarmientosaurus had very large eye sockets, suggesting it may have had better vision than other titanosaurs.
facts.quote: Tenía las cuencas de los ojos muy grandes, lo que significa que pudo haber tenido una mejor visión que otros titanosaurianos.

facts.statement: Based on the ear and neck tendon, Sarmientosaurus likely held its head and neck down "like a huge Igor".
facts.quote: Basado en el tendón de la oreja y el cuello, Sarmientosaurus probablemente mantenía la cabeza y el cuello hacia abajo "como un enorme Ígor".

facts.statement: This posture implies that Sarmientosaurus may have eaten plants much lower than other sauropods.
facts.quote: Esta postura implica que Sarmientosaurus puede haber comido plantas mucho más bajas que otros saurópodos.

facts.statement: The correlation between the inner ear structure and head posture has been questioned in previous studies.
facts.quote: La correlación entre la estructura del oído interno y la postura de la cabeza ha sido cuestionada en estudios previos.
